a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both with empty units. I don't think that plan works anymore, so I'm proposing we change it, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random, which is at least a fair coin. If any rounds follow, I'll operate the generator with you so you can fill your unit.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the reserve goes entirely to you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
